_about: Inputs for npm --prefix provider run measure. These are the expected labels and highlights for the guided demo's four scenario notes (the note text itself comes from src/data/guided-scenario.json), so `measure` checks the exact notes the demo sends before the e2e cassettes are re-recorded. The larger generated benchmark lives in scripts/gen-cases/generated-cases.json (npm run measure:generated); see scripts/gen-cases/README.md. `expected` is an authored synthetic reference, not clinician-validated; `highlight` is a substring of the sentence a reader expects highlighted, or null when no sentence gives a dose.
